rationale: cli/sprint/run.py's _run_issue_with_wall_clock_timeout() calls process_issue_inplace() directly (sequential, no worktree) and feeds two record_orchestration_run(driver='ll-sprint') calls (~L694, ~L842) that pass no base SHA. Capturing inside process_issue_inplace() and returning the stamp on IssueProcessingResult gives one capture point shared by ll-auto and sprint-sequential; each caller forwards it to its own record_orchestration_run call. Worktree-mode sprint waves remain covered transitively by the ll-parallel stamp.
rule: ll-sprint's sequential process_issue_inplace() path is IN scope for the SHA stamp, covered as a variant of the ll-auto site: capture pre-Phase-1 inside process_issue_inplace() and expose base_sha/base_dirty on IssueProcessingResult
alternatives_rejected: Separate rev-parse in cli/sprint/run.py: duplicates the capture and can race with Phase 1 mutations; exempting the path: leaves the exact merge-base-fallback gap this issue exists to close.
